nodes.norm_label: visible orchestration and atomic api split
nodes.rationale: n8n keeps orchestration inspectable while FastAPI owns authentication, versioned contracts and atomic persistence.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Domain State Boundary
nodes.rationale: Durable domain state belongs in PostgreSQL so concurrent messages, waits and restarts do not depend on individual n8n executions.

nodes.label: Versioned Approval and Honest Delivery
nodes.rationale: Approval binds exact content and version; unknown provider outcomes require reconciliation rather than blind retries.

nodes.label: Offline-Safe Demonstration
nodes.rationale: A local fixture-driven profile makes the project reproducible without implying that deterministic mock output proves live AI quality.

nodes.label: Deterministic Time-Phased Impact and Risk
nodes.rationale: Time-aware allocation and versioned rules keep quantities, dates, exposure and severity reproducible and evidence-backed.

nodes.label: Transactional Approval Work Queue
nodes.rationale: Atomic state and work-item persistence plus leases and tokens protect at-least-once processing across failures.
